owners.label: Immersive Performance
owners.description: Casting Resonance Skill or Heavy Attack increases Roccia's ATK by 20% for 12s.

owners.label: Super Attractive Magic Box
owners.description:
After casting Outro Skill, the Utility of the incoming Resonator is replaced with Magic Box.


Magic Box

- Upon use, pull nearby targets toward the Magic Box, dealing 100 points of Havoc DMG. This skill is considered Echo Skill that deals Utility DMG.
- The Magic Box lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

owners.label: Applause, Please!
owners.description: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 20% and Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

owners.label: When Shadows Engulf the Hull
owners.description:
Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick grants 100 additional Imagination and 10 Concerto Energy.
Immune to interruptions when casting Basic Attack Real Fantasy

owners.label: When the Luceanite Gleams
owners.description: Casting Basic Attack Real Fantasy grants all Resonators in the team 10% Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s, stacking up to 3 time. Upon reaching the max stacks, it grants all Resonators in the team 10% additional Havoc DMG Bonus for 30s.

owners.label: When the Heart Sees and Hands Feel
owners.description: Casting Intro Skill Pero, Help increases Roccia's Crit. Rate by 10% and Crit. DMG by 30% for 15s.

owners.label: When Wonders Gather in the Box
owners.description: Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick increases Basic Attack Real Fantasy's DMG Multiplier by 60% for 12s.

owners.label: When Dreams Are Reborn on Stage
owners.description: Increase Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso!'s DMG Multiplier by 20% and Heavy Attack's DMG Multiplier by 80%.

owners.label: When the Golden Wings Fly
owners.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso! grants the following effects for 12s:
- Basic Attack Real Fantasy ignores enemies' DEF by 60%.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. In this state, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Reality Recreation, dealing DMG equal to 100% of Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3 DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Roccia is immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack Reality Recreation.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Reality Recreation, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. Basic Attack Reality Recreation is only available in the Beyond Imagination state.

owners.label: Commedia Improvviso!
owners.description: Roccia's Crit. Rate over 50% is converted into teamwide flat ATK.

owners.label: Applause, Please!
owners.description: The incoming Resonator gains Havoc DMG Amplification and Basic Attack DMG Amplification.
